pages.text: $(o)A serpent of the deep, coiled in a flooded hall of the $(l)Sunken City$().$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Out of the water it cannot be touched. Fight it in its element, and bring water breathing for everyone.$(br2)Carry more air than you think you need.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Abyssal Scale$() counts for the quest book, and its quest marks the way to the Frontier.
